seoTitle: Box and Whisker Plot Maker with Outliers (SVG)
metaDescription: Paste one column per group to draw box plots with median, quartiles, 1.5 IQR whiskers and outlier points plus a summary table.
intro: Draws a box plot per column: median line, quartile box, Tukey whiskers and outlier dots, with a five-number summary table.
why:
Box plots compare spread and centre across groups at a glance. Here the quartiles use linear interpolation, the same as Excel QUARTILE.INC and R type 7, and the table shows the exact numbers so you can check them.

Whiskers run to the most extreme value within 1.5 times the interquartile range of the box; points beyond that are drawn as outliers. That is a convention, not a verdict: an outlier may be a data error or the most interesting row.
howTo: Paste a header row of group names and the numbers below each.
Check the summary table for min, quartiles, median, max and whisker ends.

faq.a: Linear interpolation (Excel QUARTILE.INC, R type 7). Other methods give slightly different quartiles for small samples.
Values more than 1.5 IQR beyond the box.
Quartiles match Python statistics.quantiles with the inclusive method for the sample data.
